exposure: abnormal third trimester oral glucose tolerance tests
Third trimester oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) results
Normal vs. abnormal third trimester OGTT results
cohort: 334 women with singleton pregnancies who had negative gestational diabetes test results earlier in pregnancy
finding: Women with abnormal third trimester OGTT results had a higher incidence of post-term induction of labor and cesarean delivery but no significant increase in serious maternal or perinatal adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with an abnormal third trimester OGTT result had a higher rate of cesarean delivery (31.1% vs 15.2%, aOR 2.57, 95% CI 1.14-5.81, P=0.023), regardless of surgery indication.
